# `house_disbursement_pdf_pages`

**House PDF page coverage**

Every selected physical House report page, including pending images and financial grids outside the ledger.

**Coverage.** Window. The same selected PDFs as house_disbursement_pdf_rows. Visiting a page does not establish that image content or all financial tables were interpreted. *(measured 2026-11-06)*

**Data quality.** A page can contain several offices, so office context belongs to individual financial rows. Native text is preserved even when no ledger is recognized. Header inheritance requires contiguous physical and printed pages with the same geometry. Pending image content remains distinct from empty success.

- **Parquet file:** `house_disbursement_pdf_pages.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
